summary: T27 RPC. src/rpc/router.mjs implements the full 39/39 method table from 03-SERVICES-RPC.md (matching spec/RPC-METHODS.json) with per-method schema validation, local-owner bearer auth where the payload cannot declare identity, the [actorKind,actorId,method,requestId] idempotency key with a canonical input hash (same key+hash replays the redacted result, a different hash is CONFLICT, 24h/10000), strict base64url pagination cursors, redaction, and signal cancellation. src/rpc/server.mjs is the loopback admin port: 127.0.0.1:0 only, 32-byte bearer token in runtime-control.json (0600), POST /v1/rpc, 1MiB body cap, GET cannot mutate, idempotent stop that deletes the token file. Honest notes: the RPC server is not yet started by the composition root (T28/T30 wiring), notifications.test/interactions.settle need a host/network injected by that composition root, and accounts.health.appliedRevision currently reports the account revision. Verification: npm run check passes (83 source files); npm test 517 pass / 0 fail.
